title: ¹H NMR spectrum of ethanol
caption: Ethanol has three hydrogen environments, so three peaks in a 3:2:1 ratio. The CH₃ is split into a triplet by the two neighbouring CH₂ hydrogens, the CH₂ into a quartet by the three CH₃ hydrogens, and the O–H is a singlet because it exchanges rapidly.
alt: Spectrum with a triplet at 1.2 ppm (3H), a quartet at 3.7 ppm (2H) and a singlet at 2.6 ppm (1H), and the structure of ethanol.
description: δ 1.2, 3H, triplet: CH₃ next to CH₂.
δ 3.7, 2H, quartet: CH₂ next to O and CH₃.
